To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
pruning and hyperonymization of association rules can be used to improve text classification performance.
the pruning methods, when applied to association rules, improve classification accuracy and reduce the number of rules.

(a) pruning based on tf-idf ranks of words is a good way to reduce the size of itemsets, (b) dependency syntax pruning is a better way to prune than tfidf pruning, and (c) using the hyperonymization method to enhance the itemsets is a good way of increasing the accuracy of the classifier.
In summary, our research is concerned with
two main issues.
the problem of text classification via association rules, and the impact of various techniques for improving the classification results.
the following questions: (1) How to prune itemsets based on dependency syntax? (2) How to replace words by their hyperonym of various orders? (3) How to combine pruning and enhancing methods?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed methods can improve the performance of text classification.
pruning based on tf-idf rank of words is better than pruning based on dependency syntax.
pruning based on dependency syntax outperforms pruning based on tfidfrank.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
pruning and hyperonymization methods can improve the accuracy of text classification, while dependency pruning is not as effective.
we have shown that pruning methods are more effective than enhancing methods for text classification, and that the dependency pruning method is the most effective one.
pruning methods based on syntax are better than pruning methods based on tfidf, and that enhancing methods are better than pruning.
The main takeaway from our work is that
pruning based on dependency syntax is a good way to reduce the number of features and that the best results are obtained when using a combination of both methods.
pruning based on dependency relations is more effective than pruning based on tf-idf rank.
the pruning methods can improve accuracy of text classification by up to 10% while the enhancement methods can improve the accuracy of the classification by 20% to 30%.
